strengths: Proper use of configureStore and Provider
Correct TypeScript usage and type definitions
Logical code organization and separation of concerns
improvements: In src/store/store.ts, consider adding a reducer for the store instead of an empty object
In src/main.tsx, consider adding a check for store initialization before rendering the app
In src/App.tsx, consider using a more robust routing solution instead of react-router-dom
In src/store/hooks.ts, consider adding type guards for useDispatch and useSelector
In src/global.d.ts, consider adding more type declarations for CSS files
